source_specific_notes.note: Manufacturer application evidence (Bosch Rotating Machines, Starters and Alternators Auto Electrical Spares Manual V6.0 (2023), Tata Motors starter application chart; exact ORC number F 002 G20 517): in the Tata Sumo Gold row (vehicle reference 551115400106; starter type R78 M10 TP 12V), Bosch lists F 002 G20 517 in the overrunning-clutch (ORC) column. This is a specific starter-assembly application, not a blanket cross-vehicle fitment. Sumo Gold is not a separate entry in the current vehicle master; no vehicle mapping is added. Confirm starter family, shaft/gear geometry and physical part marking before supply. Source: https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/parts_11/starter_and_alternator/bosch-starters-alternatrors-catalogue.pdf

Manufacturer/distributor application confirmation (Uno Minda 4W Electrical Catalogue, exact product code H7-7005): H7 12V 55W halogen bulb, application category “UNIVERSAL”. This is a bulb-format/voltage category, not confirmation that every vehicle headlamp accepts it. Verify H7 socket, 12V supply, 55W rating, lamp housing and local lighting approval before supply. Source: https://unomindakart.com/catalog/open/19/Electrical%20Catalogue%20-%204W.pdf

Manufacturer/distributor application confirmation (Uno Minda SW-0337 catalogue/product listing, exact product code SW-0337): identified as an idle/miscellaneous switch with vehicle compatibility “M&M - UNIVERSAL” and tractor segment. The universal designation is limited to the M&M tractor application family; it is not an all-makes/all-models claim. Verify terminal pinout, connector keying, switch actuation and mounting before supply. Source: https://unomindakart.com/product/uno-minda-sw-0337-miscellaneous-switch-for-mahindra-mahindra-tractors-universal
